title: HapticEvent
description: A request from the virtual world for physical feedback. Unreal emits these; the haptic bus applies the experiment condition (delay, remap, drop) and drives hardware. Unreal never talks to actuators directly.

id.description: Unique per run, so latency can be measured end to end.

timestamp.description: LSL clock seconds when the virtual event occurred (e.g. collision).

kind.description: contact/impact = localized touch; pulse = repeating (mana core); flow = traveling sequence; rumble = bass shaker; airflow = fans.

pattern.description: Named waveform/pattern, e.g. 'click', 'buzz', 'heartbeat', or a DRV2605L effect name.

path.description: For kind=flow: ordered zones the sensation travels through, e.g. [core, chest, right_shoulder, right_forearm, right_hand].

step_ms.description: For kind=flow: onset spacing between successive zones.
